title: Why we do not pitch with finished work
excerpt: Free creative in a pitch looks generous and helps nobody. What we show instead, and why clients tend to prefer it.
content:
Free creative in a pitch looks generous and helps nobody. It is made without knowing the client, so it is a guess, and the client ends up choosing between guesses.

What we show instead

An hour of our thinking about your problem, the three questions we would start with, and two past projects that had the same shape. Then a paid first week, so that both sides can change their minds cheaply.

A pitch should show how an agency thinks, not what it would have made if it knew you.
